note: IMMUTABLE. Do not edit these values. Re-hardening or new tasks = a NEW version (v2), never an edit to v1. This is what makes scores comparable across models over time.

official_run_config.tools: OFF (mandatory - with a code interpreter these tasks are trivial)
official_run_config.scoring: per-item conjunctive exact-match (headline) + per-row/per-part marginal accuracy (graded, primary); no LLM judge
official_run_config.validity_guard: only trust items with stop_reason == 'end_turn'. max_tokens = truncated, None = timeout - both invalid.

caveats: Calibrated against Opus 4.8 ONLY (Bedrock-only constraint). Cross-model discrimination (GPT-5/Gemini-3/Grok) is UNVERIFIED - run a panel to confirm the ranking/headroom claim.
The hard signal leans on LIFE (36%); ECA110 (56%) is moderate; DAYNIGHT (68%) and ECA30 (88%) are easier tiers adding discrimination range.
Scores are budget-sensitive (fixed 64k). LIFE verified robust 40k->64k; easier tiers not stress-tested for budget-sensitivity.
Sample n=25, no confidence intervals; ~+/-10% band. Domain is two cellular-automata families (faithful long-horizon simulation).
